title: Undertake Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) training
summary: Learn about the mandatory Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) training required for staff working with gaming machines in registered clubs or hotels.
intro:
If you're going to work in a registered club or hotel and your duties involve gaming machines, you must complete competency training in the Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG).

The Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) training clarifies the roles, duties, and expectations of gaming staff.

The training also provides the practical skills to:
who_can_apply: Working in a registered club or hotel with duties involving gaming machines
Holding a senior role within hotels and clubs that operate gaming machines
what_you_need: Complete Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) training
Complete the RCG Refresher online course every five years
Complete Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) training (if applicable)
Apply for an RCG competency card

faqs.q: Who must complete the Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) training?
faqs.a: You must complete RCG training if you work in a registered club or hotel and your duties involve gaming machines.

faqs.q: How often do I need to complete the RCG training?
faqs.a: You must complete the RCG Refresher online course every five years to keep your competency.

faqs.q: Is the Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) training for everyone?
faqs.a: ARCG is required if you are a Responsible Gambling Officer (RGO) or hold a senior role within hotels and clubs that operate gaming machines.
